title: Extreme Nash Imbalance: >600x Overpowered Generator (G >> D)
intuition: Reverses capacity asymmetry: pits a >600x larger 2.2x-amplified off-manifold generator (512x4) against a tiny 32x2 Fourier-1 tilted critic on a 16-mode ring, directly stressing Law 4.3 displacement/Kreiss control.
failure_mode: Without displacement and Kreiss control, the massive generator rockets past the tiny critic in violent non-normal excursions before the critic can build an informative potential.
